_authority: docs/GAME_DESIGN.md §5 (premise, milestones, failure states) + §3.4 (tariff script) + §4.3 (unlock years). Family rule: every number carries a rationale. Star convention (noted per §4.7 'thresholds authored in the campaign script'): where §5 gives a single pass number, ★★ = pass, ★★★ = pass with ~20 % margin, ★ = near-miss within ~10 % — encoded explicitly per milestone below.

calendar._rationale: ledger 15: 12 representative epoch-days per year (one per month, mid-month doy). Campaign year Y = start_year + floor(sim_day / 12); month = sim_day % 12 (0 = January). '2 months' in §5 milestone text = 2 sim-days, '5-day episode' = 5 sim-days spanning ~5 game-months compressed — episode durations keep §5's day COUNTS (they are felt durations, not calendar spans).

eras._rationale: §5.2 milestone 2: 'CO2 jumps to 60 €/t mid-year' — mid-2026 = day 18. Coal/gas swap in the merit order at ~55-65 €/t with the PARAMETERS §4 fuel prices.
2029: the §5.1 ratchet's third step lands with the Dunkelflaute era; tariff to 100 (§3.4 script's second value).
2033: fourth ratchet step pressing the coal deadline.
2037: final ratchet (§5.1 'by era' terminal value); tariff 105 (§3.4 third value).

unlocks._rationale: GAME_DESIGN §4.3 unlock table verbatim: battery 2027 (before milestone 4, per §5.2), HVDC + offshore platforms 2028 (mid-milestone-3), electrolyzer + cavern 2029, H2-fired retrofits 2033, wind synthetic inertia 2035 (open-question 7 default). Grid-forming firmware and syncon conversion (2031) are listed for completeness but have no buildable yet — they gate nothing until their tools exist.

milestones.title: Take the Reins (2025)

stars._rationale: §5.2.1 'no UFLS, replay viewed' = pass = ★★; ★★★ additionally holds the scripted trip's nadir above 49.5 (comfortable FCR margin — the trip_reaction pin shows 49.56 on the healthy inherited fleet); ★ tolerates one shed stage (near-miss).

milestones._window_rationale: The tutorial's GRADED exam is the scripted trip (§5.2.1 'survive the scripted 1.2 GW trip... no UFLS'): the pass window brackets it (day 1.5-2.0). The first 1.5 free-play days are ungraded — the inherited world's organic morning-ramp dip (a real pre-aFRR artifact: nuclear-heavy fleet, 19-min ramps, 15-min dispatch cadence, thin FCR with nuclear participation OFF per ledger 9) sheds UFLS stage 1 around 06:45 and is itself a teaching moment, not a milestone fail.

stars._rationale: §5.2.2 'average cost < 90 €/MWh for 6 months at ★★+ reliability': the 6 cost months are the post-ratchet half-year (days 18-24); ★★★ cost = 20 % under, ★ = 10 % over; reliability ★★ = the §5.2.5 '≤ 2 UFLS' yardstick applied to the window.

§5.2.3 verbatim: RE ≥ 20 GW, ≥ 4 GW hub-connected offshore committed (committed = platforms placed — the 42-month build makes delivery early-2030s, ledger 28), redispatch < 200 M€/yr, zero UFLS. ±20 %/10 % star convention.

§5.2.4 'SAIDI < 30 min across the episode'. SAIDI here = Σ_blocks (1 − mean zone supplied) × 15 min (the wire's supplied fraction IS the served-load share — UFLS w and blackout both land in it). ★★★ = essentially uninterrupted (< 5 min).
§5.2.5 verbatim: 0 MW coal by Jan 2035 (day 120), ≤ 2 UFLS events in the final year (days 108-120).
§5.2.6 verbatim: ≥ 5 GW electrolysis, ≥ 400 GWh_th cavern (≈ 3 four-kiloton caverns at 133 GWh_th each, PARAMETERS §1.14), ≥ 4 GW converted gas; Dunkelflaute II survived on H2 + residual gas.

§5.2.7 verbatim: ≥ 70 % inverter energy share + ★★★ reliability + < 50 gCO2/kWh over the final year; the scripted double contingency (largest hub + largest unit within 10 s, ledger 28's matched pair) must be survived — its passed replay is the closing screen.

insolvency._rationale: §5.3: treasury < −2 B€ for 90 real days = 3 representative days (a month per day).

coal_deadline._rationale: §5.3: coal past Jan 2035 (day 120) → 100 M€/month fines, milestone failed — painful, not instant fail.

scripted_events._rationale: §5.2.1 'the scripted 1.2 GW trip', afternoon of the second inherited month (day 1, 14:00). trip_nearest_mw picks the ONLINE sync unit closest to 1.2 GW output (ties → larger) — deterministic against any inherited fleet.

§5.2.3 'scripted congestion on the North Sea → Ruhr axis': a strong-wind day (+35 % λ) over the German Bight saturates the near-shore AC export corridors — congestion, not a frequency event. Staircased over 8 blocks (2 h): instant λ steps relay out wind fleets (P7/P8 hard lesson).

§5.2.4 scripted 5-day calm-cold episode over NW Europe; scales per PARAMETERS §3.4 Dunkelflaute regime (λ × 0.35, clearness × 0.6 tightened to 0.5 for the scripted teaching instance); entry AND exit staircased.
§5.2.6 Dunkelflaute II — slightly harsher (λ × 0.30): by 2035 the fleet leans harder on wind, the test must still bite.
§5.2.7 finale: largest offshore hub + largest online unit within 10 s — both genuine infeed losses (ledger 28). Survivable only with grid-forming + FFR + syncon sizing.
